coordinates.boundsMeaning: Estimated layout allocation, including leading and padding; not glyph ink bounding boxes.

conversion.note: Scale every pixel-valued field, including chart plots, radii, strokes and negative-space zones. Keep ratios, percentages, angles and normalized fractions unchanged.

integrationNotes: Choose a role-specific kit rather than coercing team, charts, cover and pricing into feature.
